_comment: Official pymss plugin registry. Each entry maps a short install name to its source. Values may be a plain git URL string, or an object {url, subpath, description, tags} for plugins that live in a subdirectory of a collection repo. To add a plugin, send a PR editing this file.

dynamics.description: Dynamics processing: compressor, limiter, expander, multiband, de-esser (pedalboard)

spectral.description: Parametric EQ and filter family: highpass/lowpass/bandpass/notch, shelves, Baxandall (scipy biquad)

analysis.description: Audio measurement: LUFS, true peak, RMS, dynamic range, spectrum (pyloudnorm)
